_doc: The groove of item's Line 8 profiles (40 mm modular dimension). Opening, width under the lips, depth and lip are item's table of groove dimensions; the floor's width and the angle of the flanks are scaled off item's drawing, and say so. The drawn slot has straight flanks where item's are curved, and leaves out the rounded mouth. item's groove faces also lean inward by 0.2 mm (its dimension e), so that a fastening pulls them flat: left out here.
name: slot-8-item

opening.rule: Groove opening, dimension a: 8.0 +0.4 for Line 8

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip, dimension d: 4.5 +0.3

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, dimension b: 20.0 +0.4

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the groove's floor, dimension c: 12.25 +0.3

floor_width.rule: Width of the floor, taken where the flanks' lines meet it: the walls curve in from about 6 mm below the face to a rounded floor; the hollow between the cells of the 80x40 shows the same flank as a straight line at 45 degrees ending 7.75 mm wide. Not dimensioned: measure yours
floor_width.source: scaled off item's section drawing of 0.0.026.03, https://cdn.item24.com/product-assets/GRA_PMA_PRF_02603-x_%23SALL_%23AINO_%23V1.svg (the drawing prints no figure for it)

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees on average (they are curved). Not dimensioned
flank_angle.source: scaled off item's section drawing of 0.0.026.03, https://cdn.item24.com/product-assets/GRA_PMA_PRF_02603-x_%23SALL_%23AINO_%23V1.svg (the drawing prints no figure for it)

nut_family.rule: It takes item's Line 8 T-slot nuts
